title: Your $5 coffee is really costing you $185,000
disclaimer: Hypothetical: $152/month at a 7% average annual return, compounded monthly. Not financial advice — real returns vary.

scenes.narration: Your daily five dollar coffee isn't really costing you five dollars. Guess what it actually costs.
Five dollars a day is about one hundred and fifty two dollars a month. Spend it on coffee, or invest the same amount at seven percent. Same money, one habit, thirty years.
So what does thirty years of that coffee money actually add up to? Take a guess before the reveal.

lines.text: What does it add up to?

scenes.narration: After thirty years, the coffee is gone. But invested, that same money grows to about one hundred and eighty five thousand dollars.
You'd put in about fifty five thousand, and end with around one hundred and eighty five thousand. It was never really about the coffee.

visual.post: It was never about the coffee.
